name: Ring of Warmth

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Resistance to Cold damage; you and what you wear are unharmed by temperatures down to -50 °F.
text: Wearing this ring grants Resistance to Cold damage, and cold down to -50 degrees Fahrenheit can't harm you or anything you wear and carry.
